baseline.method: Independent precision continuation of the unchanged author posterior API; all four starts converge

metric_definitions.period_abs_day: maximum absolute period error over both planets
metric_definitions.epoch_phase_abs_day: maximum epoch difference wrapped into half the reference period
metric_definitions.omega_phase_abs_rad: maximum circular angular difference in radians
metric_definitions.amplitude_abs_mps: maximum absolute semi-amplitude error in m/s
metric_definitions.offset_abs_mps: maximum absolute error over three instrument offsets in m/s
metric_definitions.jitter_abs_mps: maximum absolute error over three jitter standard deviations in m/s

rationale: Tight original parameter tolerances retained unchanged after independently converging the same author posterior from four starts. Original-coordinate solution spread is at most3.81e-5; four objective values agree within1.16e-11. Numerical reference is a well-converged MAP, not the default premature stopping point or physical truth. Observation consistency is additionally required.
